title: Yul, Inline Assembly, and Advanced Language Features
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Yul, Inline Assembly, and Advanced Language Features and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 19: Yul, Inline Assembly, and Advanced Language Features; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 19 roadmap: Introduction to Yul; Yul Syntax and Variables; EVM Memory Operations in Yul; Storage Operations in Yul; Calldata and Return-Data Handling; Inline Assembly Blocks; Low-Level Call and Revert Handling; Bit Packing and Bit Manipulation; Understanding Transient Storage; Using tload and tstore Where Supported; EVM Memory-Safety Considerations; Reading and Writing Low-Level Optimizations; Risks of Assembly and Low-Level Code. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
